acceptance_evidence: Test counts before and after, captured in the ledger
completion_conditions: Its binding on mergegate_check's own DEFAULT_REQUIRED_CHECKS is preserved by an explicit assertion in the derivation file.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes with a net test count consistent with the move.
non_goals: No source change under scripts/; this is test-only.
Do not move the load_shiki_config parity or configured_required_review tests; those are config-loading concerns, not required-checks derivation.
Do not weaken coverage: nothing the removed test asserted may become unasserted.
outcome: All coverage of configured_required_checks' fallback behaviour lives in tests/test_required_checks_derivation.py, the file whose docstring already names it the canonical home; tests/test_config_loading.py keeps only config-parsing and review-policy coverage, with no loss of what its removed test bound.
title: Consolidate required-checks fallback coverage into one test file
